units.source_text: 今天是四月初八，六条院内举行浴佛会。

en.t: Today was the eighth day of the fourth month, and a Buddha-bathing ceremony was held at Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 寺院先将佛像一尊送来，导师则须迟迟来到。

en.t: The temple first sent over a Buddha image, while the officiating priest was to arrive later.

units.source_text: 诸夫人都派女童送布施品来，其物品与宫中一样，种类繁多。

en.t: All the ladies sent young girls with offerings, and the items were as varied as those used at court.

units.source_text: 仪式也仿照宫中，诸公子都来参与。

en.t: The ceremony too followed the court model, and all the young gentlemen came to take part.

units.source_text: 比较起严正的御前仪式来，反而异常富有意趣，令人肃然起敬。

en.t: Compared with the solemn ceremonies before the throne, this one was instead unusually charming and inspired reverent awe.

units.source_text: 夕雾心不在焉，行过仪式之后立刻打扮一下，匆匆出门，往云居雁那里去了。

en.t: Yugiri was distracted, and as soon as the ceremony was over he quickly dressed, hurried out, and went to Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 有几个青年侍女，曾与夕雾调情而并无深切关系者，此时不免妒恨。

en.t: A few young serving women who had flirted with Yugiri without having any deep bond with him could not help feeling jealous and resentful.

units.source_text: 夕雾与云居雁多年相思，一旦团圆，夫妻自然格外恩爱，真所谓“密密深情不漏水”了。

en.t: Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari had long yearned for each other, and once reunited as husband and wife they were naturally especially loving, truly inseparable in their deep affection.

units.source_text: 岳父内大臣走近来仔细看看夕雾，觉得果然是个乘龙快婿，便越发看重他了。

en.t: His father-in-law, the Inner Minister, came closer and looked Yugiri over carefully, decided that he truly was an excellent son-in-law, and valued him all the more.

units.source_text: 他想起了对他让步之事，虽然犹有余恚，但念夕雾为人诚实，多年以来，不变初心，耐心等候，此志可嘉，自当曲予原谅。

en.t: He remembered how he had yielded to him, and though some resentment still remained, he thought of Yugiri's honesty, his unchanged devotion through the years, and his patient waiting, and judged such resolve worthy of praise and forgiveness.

units.source_text: 自此以后，云居雁的居处比弘徽殿女御那里更加繁荣了。

en.t: From then on, Kumoi no Kari's residence became even more flourishing than that of the Kokiden consort.

units.source_text: 因此内大臣的正夫人及其随身侍女等心怀妒意，啧有烦言。

en.t: Because of this, the Inner Minister's principal wife and her attending women grew jealous and voiced many complaints.
But what harm could that do?

units.source_text: 云居雁的生母按察使夫人闻知女儿嫁得佳婿，深为庆慰。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari's birth mother, the Azechi Lady, heard that her daughter had married such a fine husband and was deeply pleased and comforted.
